profile.headline: Software Developer | UI/UX Design | Human-Centered Solutions
profile.summary:
As a graduate of the University of Iowa majoring in Informatics with a focus on Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), I am passionate about designing and developing intuitive, user-centric interfaces. My hands-on experience ranges from founding startups to working in scientific labs, all while applying my technical skills in web development, user interface design, and strategy.

I co-founded AutoCompete, LLC, where I placed 3rd at Startup Games in Spring 2023. Additionally, as the founder of ParkingBuddy, LLC, I continue to solve real-world problems through entrepreneurial ventures. My technical stack includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and Java, alongside tools like Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite.

In my roles as a Laboratory Technician at Eurofins Scientific and Corteva Agriscience, I streamlined processes by developing automation tools with Visual Basic, trained teams, and implemented quality protocols that significantly boosted productivity and accuracy.

I'm always excited about new opportunities to create, innovate, and contribute to projects at the intersection of design, technology, and business.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop and maintain production React applications and internal tooling deployed across multiple construction business units and internal departments. Build full-stack web and mobile applications using React frontends and Java/Spring Boot backends, solving real-world operational challenges for a large construction organization. Embedded within the DevOps team under mentorship of the DevOps Team Lead, contributing to deployment workflows, code quality standards, and cross-team technical collaboration. Debug, refactor, and validate frontend and backend codebases to improve reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability. Build reusable UI components with a focus on clarity, consistency, and testability across business units. Produce and maintain clear technical documentation supporting onboarding, long-term reuse, and evaluation of in-house developed software. Collaborate with non-technical stakeholders to translate loosely defined business problems into concrete, well-scoped technical tasks. Participate in code review, testing, and troubleshooting workflows to ensure correctness and solution quality.
